items.name: pricing-anim-001
items.title: Тарифы
items.description: Полноширинная секция тарифов: 2–3 карточки со списком фич и ценой въезжают по мере прокрутки, а выделенный популярный план держит дышащее свечение рамки.
items.docs: Компонент самодостаточен: один файл, ноль зависимостей, палитра в локальных --vibeui-pricing-anim-001-*. Тему берёт из окружения через light-dark() плюс строку для класса .dark. Сетка карточек переключается со столбца на три колонки по @container (min-width:52rem). Карточки въезжают по мере прокрутки секции в вид через scroll-driven view-timeline (тот же приём, что у activity-001): у каждой карточки свой animation-range, на браузерах без поддержки view-timeline они сразу видны в конечном состоянии. Выделенная карточка дополнительно держит независимую бесконечную анимацию дыхания рамки и свечения (glow), не завязанную на прокрутку.

en.title: Pricing
en.description: A full-width pricing section with plan cards and features: 2–3 cards with a feature list and price rise in on scroll, while the highlighted popular plan holds a breathing frame glow.
en.docs: The component is self-contained: one file, zero dependencies, palette in local --vibeui-pricing-anim-001-* variables. It takes the theme from the environment via light-dark() plus a rule for the .dark class. The card grid switches from a column to three columns at @container (min-width:52rem). Cards rise in as the section scrolls into view via a scroll-driven view-timeline (the same technique as activity-001): each card has its own animation-range, and browsers without view-timeline support simply show them in their final state. The highlighted card additionally holds an independent infinite frame-breathing and glow animation, unrelated to scrolling.

ai.summary: A full-width pricing section: cards with a price and feature list rise in on scroll, and the highlighted plan breathes with a frame glow. Zero dependencies, one file, no client JS.
preserve: the local --vibeui-pricing-anim-001-* palette — do not swap it for your theme tokens
the scroll-driven view-timeline card rise with a positional stagger — the section's signature
the breathing frame glow on the highlighted (popular) card, independent of scrolling
the "Popular" badge and the solid accent button only on the highlighted plan
the grid switching from a column to three columns via @container, not viewport media
the .dark class rule: without it the section stays light on a dark page in another project
adapt: the plan set via the plans prop: name, price, period, feature list, button label
which plan is marked popular (exactly one)
the section title and subtext, the accent color via the accent prop
notes: plans supports 2–3 items; the grid is tuned for that density
the scroll-driven rise needs view-timeline support; without it cards are simply shown at once
